hookLine: Ranking the most painful gym fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Using the treadmill completely backwards.
Number 4: The resistance band snapping right into the face.
Number 3: Dropping the dumbbell straight onto your toes.
Number 2: Ripping your pants during a deep squat.
Number 1: Flying off the pull-up bar straight into the mirror!
